title.en: Chest/back pain and progressive weakness · man aged 46

summary.zh-CN: 长期抗病毒治疗者出现难以解释的骨痛、骨折与行走困难，核对药物史及血尿生化组合。

name.zh-CN: 乙肝监测与肾动态显像

zh-CN: 乙肝监测与肾动态显像

text.zh-CN: HBsAg、抗HBe及抗HBc阳性，HBV DNA低于4.2×10² copies/mL；肾动态显像报告双肾滤过中度受损，无具体GFR数值。
text.en: HBsAg, anti-HBe and anti-HBc were positive; HBV DNA <4.2×10² copies/mL. Renal scintigraphy reported moderate bilateral filtration impairment without a numerical GFR.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 原报告停用阿德福韦，改用恩替卡韦，并补磷、钾及钙/活性维生素D等。停药后磷未立刻恢复；出院时症状改善。约半年复查磷0.81、钾3.6 mmol/L，尿糖阴性，能大步行走且疼痛减轻。
text.en: The report stopped adefovir, substituted entecavir and provided phosphate, potassium and calcium/active vitamin D support. Phosphate did not normalise immediately; symptoms improved by discharge. About six months later phosphate was 0.81 and potassium 3.6 mmol/L, urine glucose was negative and walking and pain had improved.

text.zh-CN: 阿德福韦相关近端肾小管功能障碍（范科尼综合征）伴低磷性骨软化
text.en: Adefovir-associated proximal tubular dysfunction (Fanconi syndrome) with hypophosphataemic osteomalacia

feedback.zh-CN: 正常血糖下尿糖、肾小管蛋白、酸中毒和低磷共同指向近端肾小管障碍。
feedback.en: Glycosuria with normal blood glucose, tubular proteinuria, acidosis and hypophosphataemia together point to proximal tubular dysfunction.

text.zh-CN: 只有普通骨质疏松，肌酐不高便可排除肾损害
text.en: Simple osteoporosis alone; a modest creatinine excludes renal damage

feedback.zh-CN: 正常血糖下尿糖、肾小管蛋白、酸中毒和低磷共同指向近端肾小管障碍。
feedback.en: Glycosuria with normal blood glucose, tubular proteinuria, acidosis and hypophosphataemia together point to proximal tubular dysfunction.

text.zh-CN: 肝病、肾内与药师协作更换可疑药物并维持合适抗HBV方案，监测电解质和肾小管恢复
text.en: Hepatology, nephrology and pharmacy coordinate replacement of the suspected drug while maintaining appropriate HBV therapy and monitoring electrolytes/tubular recovery

feedback.zh-CN: 需要同时处理毒性、抗病毒连续性和代谢异常；不能只看骨密度或肌酐。
feedback.en: Toxicity, antiviral continuity and metabolic abnormalities all need attention; densitometry and creatinine alone are insufficient.

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 骨痛背后有药物相关近端肾小管损伤；停用并更换药物后恢复是渐进的。
conclusion.en: Drug-associated proximal tubular injury underlies the bone symptoms, with gradual improvement after withdrawal and substitution.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 尿糖必须与同一阶段血糖一起解释。
keyReasoning.en: Interpret glycosuria together with contemporaneous blood glucose.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 骨质疏松与骨软化可以同时存在。

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.
